_comment: Short names shown on product cards, keyed by CAS. The full chemical name stays in the search index and on hover. Re-running scripts/import_pharma.py never overwrites this file.
_provenance: Entries marked CONFIRMED were verified against multiple independent supplier/reference databases (ChemicalBook, PharmaCompass, Sigma-Aldrich, BOC Sciences, SynZeal and named API manufacturers). Entries marked CHEMICAL make no claim about a target drug - they are shortened forms of the molecule's own name. Have a chemist sign these off before go-live.
